## 3. Wire it up

Run `npx rr add notifications`. Zero npm deps (only shadcn button + popover). Import `import { NotifyMePopover, useSubscription } from "@/features/notifications"`. Drop the popover anywhere; useSubscription(pageId) hook returns `{ isSubscribed, frequency, subscribe, unsubscribe, setFrequency }` reading from localStorage. To wire a real backend, swap the localStorage hook for your own.
